_comment: Example of the release_kit section of config.json. Setup (references/setup.md) writes it. Every value is a placeholder. Any section left null falls back to the skill's neutral default. Don't commit a real config to a shared repo.

voice._comment: source: skill, memory, pasted, linked, derived, or doc_store. source_skill names an installed voice or style skill (reference only, never its content). Saved only after the user confirms. null = default voice.
voice.example_line: <one line quoted from your own copy>

landing_page._comment: Section order of one real product page. Stores structure only, not the page's copy. null = spec 6 as written.

tiers._comment: maps_to is the closest default tier (1, 2, or 3). null for the whole list = the default three-tier menu.
tiers.name: <Your tier name>
